mapper.select: SELECT a.*, g.title AS goods_title, ub.username AS buyer_name, us.username AS seller_name FROM after_sale a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN user ub ON o.buyer_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN user us ON o.seller_id = us.id ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sale SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale(order_id, reason, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reason}, #{status}, NOW())
